name: com.xlx.speech.voicereadsdk.ui.activity.mutual.SpeechVoiceOpenActivity
description: The Xinliangxiang Voice Read SDK opens this screen for a spoken ad-reward task, showing the advertiser’s message and guiding the user through a read-aloud flow. Its close control can show instructions for leaving the task.
disableEffect: Blocking it stops this voice ad task from opening or completing, so rewards for the associated ad will no longer be granted.
